title: Rewinding the First Auxiliary Tape
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $y$ be a Boolean input word, let $P$ be one of the $|y|+2$ input-head positions, and let $b$ be a Boolean vector with one coordinate for each selector bit of $M$. Let $w$ be a Boolean word, let $\tau_1,\tau_2:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$ be tape contents, and let $z_1,z_2\in\mathbb{Z}$. For every natural number $j\le |w|$, after $j+1$ steps from the configuration whose state is the first-tape-rewinding state, whose three auxiliary tapes contain respectively $w$ starting at cell zero, $\tau_1$, and $\tau_2$, and whose auxiliary head positions are $j-1,z_1,z_2$, the machine is in the next-tape-rewinding state. The resulting tapes still contain those same contents, the input head remains at $P$, the auxiliary head positions are $0,z_1-1,z_2$, and the output is empty.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine M with Boolean symbols
An input-head position P among the |y|+2 positions
A Boolean vector b of length nbits(M)
Integer-indexed optional Boolean tape contents τ₁ and τ₂
Integer auxiliary head positions z₁ and z₂
A natural number j with j ≤ |w|
